core_obligations: Reformulate the hypothesis: a point reached by the image means that it can be specialised from an actual image point, and the quasi-compactness of the morphism makes this condition local at the point (proof lines 2115-2125)

Reduce to schemes: base change along a smooth presentation of the target so that the morphism becomes one of algebraic spaces, then reduce the quasi-compact case to affine schemes, and use that the scheme theoretic image commutes with this base change (proof lines 2126-2140)

Apply the scheme case: the corresponding statement for morphisms of schemes gives the conclusion for the presenting morphism, and the base change description returns it to the stack (proof lines 2141-2150)

取目标的满光滑展示做基变换，把映射化为概型（或代数空间）之间的映射，并用 scheme theoretic image 与平坦基变换的相容性。
由概型情形的对应命题得结论，再按基变换的描述回到栈。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a quasi-compact morphism of algebraic stacks a point of the target which is reached by the image of the morphism belongs to its scheme theoretic image (author lemma at source lines 2100-2113, label lemma-reach-points-scheme-theoretic-image). The proof (source lines 2115-2151) reformulates reachedness as a specialization condition, reduces to the corresponding statement for schemes along a smooth presentation of the target using the compatibility of the scheme theoretic image with flat base change, and returns to the stack (proof lines 2115-2150). The reformulation and the reduction are the substance. H3.
